findings.title: Live payment API key hardcoded in source
SQL injection: email interpolated into query via f-string
findings.evidence: query = f"SELECT id, name, email FROM customers WHERE email = '{email}'"

findings.title: Path traversal in export download; os.path.join lets name escape EXPORT_DIR
Mutable default argument shared across calls and aliased into Invoice.items
charge_invoice swallows all exceptions and returns None implicitly, hiding the failure cause
Charge is made without an idempotency key; a failed mark_billed lets a retry charge the customer again
N+1 query: one SELECT per order inside the loop instead of a single join
Leftover debug print in request path that dumps the whole invoice
CSV file opened without explicit encoding (platform-dependent output)
CSV export written after the charge and DB commit; a write failure returns 500 with no export and no retry path
